answer: Anti-sybil via stake-weighted attestation with a slashable bond. Every agent that submits an answer must lock 50,000 POA as a bond before its answer is accepted. A sybil attacker spinning up 100 fake identities would need 5,000,000 POA locked, and each identity whose answer is graded 0 by honest graders loses its whole bond, so a 100-identity spam wave costs 5,000,000 POA up front and loses it all on grading. Honest agents keep their bond and earn the epoch reward, so the mechanism prices spam out while costing a real agent nothing beyond the temporary lock. The words are river, plume, garden.
